verification.scope: Persistent root shell/sidebar across composition, UI and spatial routes; stable row actions and separate tree data/selection preserve unrelated titles during session insertion, deletion and rename.
verification.result: Manual instrumented Next browser checks at 20 and 200 sessions: unrelated title executions, replaced retained rows and navigation list reloads all zero; expansion and scrolling retained. Dialog typing renders neither tree nor active 3D viewport and allocates no WebGL resources. Pending actions still update global action-control availability. Typecheck, 225 domain tests (1 skipped), 34 focused tests, Next and Storybook builds passed; 24 retained sidebar/shell Story plays passed. Existing immediate-note-navigation autosave loss also reproduced with pre-change shell/layout. Production static-export navigation also retained all rows with no list reloads, overflow or Inspector. Detailed local evidence: .human2ai-data/output/workspace-tree-local-updates/verification.md. Browser checks are manual, not CI protection.

loadingLoopFix.cause: Style prompt reads published page state and repeatedly invalidated the preview reader.
loadingLoopFix.resolution: Prompt reads only return text; existing refresh/bind owns displayed style state.

unchangedReferencePolling.cause: Composition camera-reference polling published a new missing-source Set every two seconds, invalidating the page and restarting the open prompt reader even when membership was unchanged.
unchangedReferencePolling.resolution: Retain the existing missing-source Set when membership is unchanged, including an already-empty reset. Changed source availability still publishes the new Set.
unchangedReferencePolling.renderScope: Unchanged camera-reference poll -> membership comparison only -> zero CompositionPageContent, CompositionCanvas, CanvasNode and sidebar executions. Hover and prompt resolution -> local PromptContent -> four development StrictMode executions and two initial reads; sustained hover and scrolling produce no further prompt reads or canvas-node/tree DOM mutations at 20/200-area actual Next development fixtures (22/202 CanvasNodes including frame and planning). No GPU allocation claim.
unchangedReferencePolling.result: Six-second sustained-hover assertions pass at 1280x800 for both fixture sizes, retaining text, popup height, content identity, trigger position and scroll position. Keyboard focus and native pointer movement into and out of the scrollable popup pass at 1024x800.
unchangedReferencePolling.browserCoverage: Manual browser execution of retained setup-browser.js and check-hover.js against isolated actual routes; CI does not run these browser assertions.

At 20/200 nodes, zero unrelated CanvasNode executions and zero canvas DOM mutations; 20 pointer events produce one guide update and no preview API request. uiSketchSelectionDeletion.composition: Reuse the existing canvas Dropdown for the destructive actions.delete command, canonical UI group selection/cleanup and shared useCanvasHistory. ClearCanvas targets the full document; member-editor ConfirmAction targets one edited member. Neither owns selection deletion.
uiSketchSelectionDeletion.result: A selected group or marquee selection can be deleted from the context menu or with Delete/Backspace while the scene has focus. The operation commits one draft and is undone/redone as a whole, including group membership, assets/crop, layer order and all state geometry. No selection and read-only modes disable deletion; member-editor deletion remains scoped to the edited member.
uiSketchSelectionDeletion.renderScope: Delete -> removed members, previous selection/outlines, existing document/history/save consumers. In 20/200-unrelated-node development fixtures, retained Story assertions observe zero unrelated CanvasNode executions; manual native-key probes retain every unrelated SVG node and observe zero mutations within those node subtrees. Existing stage normalization and canvas reconciliation traverse the document after topology changes. Synthetic Delete dispatch to fixture document DOM commit measured 109.3/122.6ms in one development sample per size; these timings are supporting evidence only. GPU drawing/allocation was not measured.
uiSketchSelectionDeletion.verification: Retained deletion Story, read-only and member-deletion Stories pass manual browser execution at 1536x960. Web/Storybook type checks, Next production/Storybook builds, domain and i18n gates pass. Browser assertions are not run by CI; synthetic composition/modifier checks do not claim native IME coverage. Earlier no-testing group-outline change is not validated by this record.

uiSketchGroupOutlines.composition: Extend the existing UiSketchCanvas and CanvasScene with an editor-only SVG group outline, reusing CanvasNode item markers and measured text bounds. CanvasNode selection controls describe individual nodes; CanvasPreviewHover describes exported previews, so neither owns group membership feedback.
uiSketchGroupOutlines.result: Hovering any displayed member or selecting its persistent group shows the same dashed outline with 6 screen pixels of padding. A single selected group replaces the aggregate solid selection outline. Group outlines follow the existing animation-frame drag preview and cancellation cleanup; saved geometry and exported content are unchanged.
uiSketchGroupOutlines.renderScope: Pointer boundary events -> outline-local hover state -> affected group SVG outlines. Group bounds use an indexed geometry lookup; hover does not update UiSketchCanvas/page state or node resources. Selection/document changes use existing owners. This describes implementation boundaries only; React execution, DOM paint and GPU work were not measured.
uiSketchGroupOutlines.verification: Not run at the user's explicit request: no tests, type checks, builds, governance checks or browser measurements. Earlier PNG splitting verification does not cover this change.

sidebarSessionReveal.implementation: Reuse currentSessionId and AssetSkeletonTree. The application hook stores collapsed project/group keys in localStorage and injects controlled expandedKeys/onExpandedKeysChange; new containers default open. Disable automatic ancestor expansion, preserve collapsed parents across remounts, and mark the nearest visible collapsed ancestor with a solid theme-color dot and Chinese/English accessible name. After tree height motion settles, align the session or collapsed ancestor to the upper quarter of the tree viewport; native scroll clamping handles insufficient trailing content. Keep manual scrolling after revealing; unknown sessions do not scroll. No route, API or domain lifecycle changes.

Expansion checks coalesce to one animation-frame callback while height motion is active; no page or canvas state is published. Regression covers storage restoration across sidebar remounts, collapsed project/group precedence, marker styling, upper placement, bottom clamping, manual scrolling and rapid switching.
